zakatClaimEvidence: Muslim Aid USA's website explicitly states: "An annual obligation, Zakat is given by eligible adult Muslims whose wealth exceeds the Nisab threshold for a full lunar year. It directs essential support to those in need, both locally and across the globe." Additionally, their website features a dedicated 'Zakat' section with a 'Zakat Guide,' 'Zakat Calculator,' and 'Zakat Appeal,' stating, 'Support verified recipients in need through our Zakat distribution program. Verified Recipients. 8 Eligible Categories. Transparent Process. Regular Updates. Donate Zakat.' Their 'Donation Policy' also includes an 'IMPORTANT NOTE REGARDING CREDIT CARD DONATIONS FOR ZAKAT.' (Source: https://www.mausa.org/religious-dues/zakat/)

strengths_deep_dive: Muslim Aid America demonstrates solid financial allocation to direct services. In FY2024, the filed <cite id="1">Program Expense Ratio was 93.7%</cite>. Based on cash operations alone, the cash-adjusted program ratio was 84%, exceeding the industry standard benchmark of 75%. This spending efficiency is supported by low fundraising expenses, costing <cite id="1">$0.04 per $1 raised</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: Muslim Aid America provides relief programs focused on water, food, and disaster response. In FY2024, the charity managed <cite id="1">$26,971,910 in total revenue</cite> to support victims of conflict, disease, and poverty across the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. The organization's filed <cite id="1">Program Expense Ratio reached 93.7%</cite>. When excluding non-cash contributions, its cash-adjusted program ratio stands at 84%, which beats the 75% industry standard. The charity maintains low fundraising costs, spending only <cite id="1">$0.04 per $1 raised</cite>. Muslim Aid America is <cite id="2">ZAKAT-ELIGIBLE</cite> and distributes funds across recognized categories including support for the poor (fuqara) and needy (masakin). Non-cash contributions make up 62% of revenue, and the organization holds 2.1 months of working capital in reserve. Outcome tracking is documented through Candid, though the charity lacks a published theory of change.
